download_repo_files: download all files from a Hugging Face Hub repository to the local cache directory
download_specific_files: download specific files like config.json and tokenizer.json from a Hugging Face Hub model repository
download_filtered_files: download files matching glob patterns like *.safetensors while excluding *.bin files
download_to_local_dir: download an entire repository to a specified local directory instead of the cache
dry_run_download: perform a dry run to preview which files will be downloaded without actually downloading them
